scientific_integrity: The integer coefficient theorem follows from a weight-preserving reflection argument; finite exhaustive comparisons and an independent dynamic program provide reproducible checks, not a substitute for the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply to indexed binary linear Abelian-unbordered words. The sharp probability asymptotic assumes an interior Hamming density, and there is no claimed extension to larger alphabets or ordinary equality borders. Prior unweighted nonreturning-walk and Narayana results are acknowledged; historical equivalence in uncatalogued literature is a residual priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: Fixed-composition law and parity-rigid weight spectra of binary Abelian-unbordered words
